title: [E-Document] Remove Access = Internal from E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit
summary: The E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl. codeunit access level is changed from Internal to public, allowing partners to reuse its functions for custom E-Document implementations.
key_points: Access modifier removed from codeunit 6152 E-Doc. Data Exchange Impl.
Partners can now extend and reuse E-Document data exchange functions
Enables custom E-Document implementations by third parties
No behavioral changes for existing functionality
